meta.description: Knowledge graph for the robosuite Door task: a UR5e with a parallel-jaw gripper reaches a door handle and pulls the door open past a hinge angle of 0.3 rad. The door frame's position and yaw are randomized each episode. Consumed by the P4-LLM reasoning + decision components to ground failure analysis and the SELECT/BRIDGE demonstration choice. Coordinates are world-frame metres; the scripted expert uses closed-loop hinge feedback and is reliable inside the stated door-frame range.

properties.role: engagement point the gripper drives to pull the panel
reach the handle then pull along the door-opening arc

reasoning_implications.approach_failure: The gripper misses the handle (wrong xy/height for the randomized door pose): prescribe/select a scene whose door pose forces a clean approach onto the handle.
reasoning_implications.grasp_failure: The gripper reaches the handle but fails to engage it enough to pull: emphasize a firmer engagement before pulling.
reasoning_implications.pose_mismatch: The pull direction does not follow the hinge arc for this door yaw: demonstrate the correct pull direction for the cited door orientation.
reasoning_implications.contact_instability: The gripper slips off the handle mid-pull: emphasize maintaining contact through the opening arc.
reasoning_implications.timeout: Hesitation at the handle without opening past 0.3 rad: commit to engage-then-pull with the door well inside the reliable range.
reasoning_implications.workspace_constraint: Every prescribed door frame xy MUST stay within x[-0.135,-0.108] y[-0.366,-0.340] at z=1.10 (world), yaw within [-1.82,-1.57]. Out-of-range poses are unreliable and waste the round.
reasoning_implications.non_emptiness: A failure IS present, so the decision MUST cite concrete episode ids for SELECT or BRIDGE — never refuse.
